purpose: Defines one schedulable Calendar acquisition request that references Acquisition Registry system identity and does not duplicate source or adapter routing knowledge.
closure_rules: job_id and campaign_id must be lowercase kebab-case stable identifiers
system_id must resolve in the Acquisition Registry
runner_policy registry_primary_or_fallback requires runner null and a non-null registry fallback_runner
runner_policy exact requires runner equal to the registry primary_runner or fallback_runner
requested_scope must contain exactly the fields for collection_mode
date_window and source_visible_horizon require start_date before end_date_exclusive
date_window requires supports_date_window and cross-month windows additionally require supports_cross_month_window
selected_meetings requires supports_selected_meetings and a non-empty unique meeting_ids array
target_rank strategy requires target_rank not above registry technical_capability_rank
rank_upgrade_retry requires supports_rank_upgrade_retry and target_rank strategy
requested_at must be a valid date-time
Collection Jobs must not carry source IDs adapter IDs credentials source bodies publication state or promotion state
explicit_exclusions: no source_id or adapter_id duplication inside jobs
no source bodies or raw HTML
no participant horse jockey trainer betting odds result payout prediction or tip data
no credentials cookies tokens restricted-access details or bypass instructions
no approval promotion publication or deployment side effects
